MoresResearch.menu_desc: A Research Hub For Collaborative Research And Accessible Knowledge Sharing.

overview.title: mores research
overview.leftParagraph:
A research hub for collaborative research and accessible knowledge sharing.

Mores Research is a research hub developed by Mores Strategics to make evidence-based knowledge more accessible, relevant, and connected to everyday life and public interest.
overview.rightParagraph1: As a hub, Mores Research welcomes collaboration with scholars, practitioners, institutions, and communities interested in building knowledge that matters beyond academic spaces. We connect analytical depth with practical value by bringing research closer to everyday questions, real-world challenges, and the people who need clear insights to make informed decisions.
overview.rightParagraph2: Our work spans research publications, public conversations, collaborative initiatives, fellowship programs, and newsletters. Through these outputs, Mores Research aims to strengthen public understanding of research while supporting institutions, communities, and decision-makers with credible and accessible knowledge.

fellowship.title: Fellowship Program
fellowship.p1: Mores Fellowship is a six-month research fellowship hosted by Mores Research. The program is designed to nurture a community of researchers with doctoral degrees and doctoral candidates who seek to produce research with public relevance and real-world impact.
fellowship.p2: The fellowship supports research that is rigorous, relevant, and impactful for public discourse, institutional decision-making, and broader social understanding. Fellows receive communication support and access to multiple dissemination channels, enabling them to share their work with both targeted stakeholders and wider audiences.
fellowship.p3: Mores Fellows are provided with stipends, collaborative networks, publication opportunities, public engagement experiences, and pathways for long-term collaboration with Mores Research. Through this intellectual community, fellows can strengthen their research capabilities, contribute to emerging knowledge, and produce work that creates value across academic, commercial, and public spheres.

priorityAreas.title: Priority Research Areas
priorityAreas.subtitle: Mores Research welcomes researchers whose work engages with, but is not limited to, the following areas:
priorityAreas.approachP1: We believe that research should not only stop at finding answers, but also ensure those findings can be used by the wider public. Our approach combines structured data, contextual ground analysis, and clear language to translate complex social and technical dynamics into clear knowledge points.
priorityAreas.approachP2: The results of our studies are mapped directly to support communities, public policy-makers, and industry innovators. By ensuring transparency, clarity, and widespread accessibility for every publication, Mores Research helps build a better-informed society capable of responding to continuous systemic updates.

overview.title: MORESIGHT
overview.subtitle: MoreSight is a quarterly newsletter that serves as a publication platform for Mores Research, bringing research-driven ideas and analysis to a broader audience.
overview.p1: Designed for decision-makers, corporate leaders, policy analysts, and professionals, MoreSight provides macro-level analysis and actionable strategic insights to help readers navigate rapidly evolving economic, technological, and business landscapes.
overview.p2: Each edition features four carefully curated articles that combine critical insights, expert perspectives, and concise research findings. By transforming complex developments into accessible analysis, MoreSight helps readers understand emerging trends without getting lost in analytical noise.
overview.p3: Whether you are scaling a business, managing investments, shaping policy, or advising stakeholders, MoreSight offers a clear and informed perspective on the forces shaping today's world.
